whoosh-fast.prompt: Fast short air whoosh pass-by, a quick rush of air sweeping past the microphone, rising to a peak then falling away, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

whoosh-deep.prompt: Heavy deep cinematic whoosh, a large object passing by fast with low-end rumble, swells to a peak in the middle then fades out quickly, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

swish-short.prompt: Very short swish, a thin cane swiping through the air once, single quick swipe, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

whip-pan.prompt: Bright quick whip pan whoosh transition, airy high-frequency swipe, snappy and fast, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

impact-deep.prompt: Deep cinematic impact hit, a punchy transient at the very start then a powerful sub bass boom that decays within one second, single trailer hit, no riser before it, no music.

impact-brass.prompt: A solid brass plate struck once with a mallet, sharp metallic transient then a short warm metallic ring that decays fast, close-mic, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

impact-soft.prompt: Soft felt thud, a padded mallet hitting a thick leather cushion once, muffled low dull impact, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

ui-tick.prompt: One single crisp tiny click, a precise small mechanical switch tick, extremely short, one click only, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

ui-click.prompt: One single soft premium button press, a tactile muted click of a high-end device button, one press only, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

type-tick-run.prompt: Fast run of crisp mechanical keyboard key ticks, rapid typing of a short string, about fifteen quick evenly spaced clicks, close-mic, no voices, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

stitch-run.prompt: Close-up foley of a sewing needle punching through thick leather by hand, rhythmic tick-tick-tick, about six evenly spaced crisp punctures with a slight thread pull, satisfying, intimate, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.
stitch-run.note: Composite (tools/sfx/composite.mjs): 6 layered punctures ~165 ms apart; the body grain is from stitch-run v1, the crisp grain from stitch-single v2. Both stitch-run generations returned only 1-2 hits.

stitch-single.prompt: One single sewing needle punching through thick leather, a crisp tiny puncture tick, close-mic foley, one puncture only, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.
stitch-single.note: Composite: body grain (stitch-run v1) + crisp grain (stitch-single v2); matches the punctures in stitch-run. v1 was near-silent.

leather-creak.prompt: Thick leather creaking as it is bent, a short low stretched creak of a leather satchel strap, close-mic foley, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

paper-slide.prompt: A sheet of heavy paper sliding across a leather surface, one smooth short slide, close-mic foley, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

pocket-slip.prompt: A paper slip being slid into a tight leather jacket pocket, short friction slide ending in a soft settle, close-mic foley, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

riser-4s.prompt: Cinematic tension riser lasting the full four and a half seconds, starting quiet and rising steadily in pitch and intensity until the very end, cutting off abruptly at its loudest point, no impact, no drums, no music.
riser-4s.note: v2 (4.5 s generation), last 4.0 s kept so it ends at full level. v1 built for only ~3.6 s.

downlifter.prompt: Cinematic downlifter, a falling pitch sweep that starts loud then descends and fades out smoothly, no drums, no music.

sub-drop.prompt: Deep sub bass drop, a low boom that pitches down and decays, clean, no music, no other sounds.

freeze-shimmer.prompt: Subtle icy crystalline shimmer, delicate glassy sparkle like frost forming on glass, soft and short, no music.

success-brass.prompt: A warm small brass bell chime struck once, elegant positive confirmation tone, clear pleasant ring that decays naturally, no other instruments, no music.

error-low.prompt: A low muted negative tone, a soft dull descending two-note blip signalling denial, gentle, not a buzzer, not harsh, no music.

counter-roll.prompt: Fast descending digital ticks, a rapid number counter rolling down like a balance draining, quick tiny clicks, clean, no music.

scanner-sweep.prompt: Photocopier scanner light bar sweeping across the glass, a smooth electric motor hum moving from one end to the other, clean, no music.

glitch-short.prompt: Subtle short digital glitch stutter, a quick data corruption blip, clean, no music.

heartbeat-tension.prompt: Slow low tension heartbeat pulse, deep muffled thumps, dark and ominous, no music.
heartbeat-tension.note: Composite: the v2 lub-dub repeated 1.0 s later (60 bpm). v1 was one decaying hit.

lock-clunk.prompt: A heavy satisfying mechanical latch locking, solid metal clunk of a vault bolt sliding shut, single action, close-mic, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.

deposit-ping.prompt: A bright, soft, premium notification ping for an incoming payment, one single clear note like a small tuned metal bar struck gently with a soft mallet, a delicate airy sparkle on top, quick attack and short smooth decay, elegant and modern, not a cash register, not a video game coin, no music.

count-up.prompt: Fast descending digital ticks, a rapid number counter rolling down like a balance draining, quick tiny clicks, clean, no music.
count-up.note: Composite: counter-roll's ticks under a rising varispeed (0.72x to 1.0x), so it pairs with counter-roll (same tick sound, rising ~5.7 semitones, accelerating). The generated count-up (warmer, 2-8 kHz, also ascending) is kept as tools/sfx/_raw/count-up.mp3.

approve-chime.prompt: A subtle two-note confirmation chime for an approval, two soft warm mallet tones rising a gentle interval, the second note shortly after the first, quiet and reassuring, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.
approve-chime.note: Composite: the v1 note (C5, ~523 Hz) then the same note a fifth up (G5, ~785 Hz) 130 ms later. Both generations (v1, and v2 with an explicit two-note prompt) returned one sustained note.

card-flick.prompt: A quick crisp flick of a stiff leather card sliding into place, one short snappy friction swipe ending in a tiny soft tap, close-mic foley, clean, dry, no music, no reverb tail.
